tables.name: account_risk_states
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `account_risk_states` (
  `trading_account_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `business_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `equity` decimal(24,8) NOT NULL,
  `free_margin` decimal(24,8) NOT NULL,
  `daily_loss_percent` decimal(12,6) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.000000',
  `drawdown_percent` decimal(12,6) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.000000',
  `open_positions` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `pending_orders` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `total_volume` decimal(24,8) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00000000',
  `daily_open_count` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `consecutive_losses` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `terminal_timezone_offset_minutes` smallint DEFAULT NULL,
  `clock_status` enum('calibrated','observer_bootstrap','stale','unavailable') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `last_successful_open_at_utc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `cooldown_until_utc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `data_complete` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `incomplete_reasons_json` json NOT NULL,
  `observed_at_utc` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `revision` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`trading_account_id`),
  KEY `idx_account_risk_state_user` (`user_id`,`observed_at_utc`,`trading_account_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_account_risk_state_account` FOREIGN KEY (`trading_account_id`) REFERENCES `trading_accounts` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_account_risk_state_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`)

tables.name: account_trade_records_v4
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `account_trade_records_v4` (
  `id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `user_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `trading_account_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `stable_trade_key` varchar(191) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `platform` enum('mt4','mt5') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `primary_ticket` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `position_id` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `symbol` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `side` enum('buy','sell') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `status` enum('open','closed','partial','unknown') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `source_classification` enum('system','manual','other_ea','mixed','unknown') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `attribution_status` enum('exact','partial','conflicted','unresolved') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `evidence_status` enum('complete','partial','conflicted') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `volume_opened` decimal(24,8) NOT NULL,
  `volume_closed` decimal(24,8) NOT NULL,
  `entry_price` decimal(24,8) NOT NULL,
  `exit_price` decimal(24,8) DEFAULT NULL,
  `stop_loss` decimal(24,8) DEFAULT NULL,
  `take_profit` decimal(24,8) DEFAULT NULL,
  `gross_profit` decimal(24,8) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00000000',
  `commission` decimal(24,8) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00000000',
  `swap_amount` decimal(24,8) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00000000',
  `fee_amount` decimal(24,8) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00000000',
  `net_profit` decimal(24,8) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00000000',
  `opened_at_utc` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `closed_at_utc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `close_business_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `terminal_timezone_offset_minutes` smallint NOT NULL,
  `evidence_sha256` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `observed_at_utc` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `legacy_source_table` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `legacy_id` varchar(191) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at_utc` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `updated_at_utc` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `revision` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `ownership_interval_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `account_currency` varchar(16) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `currency_evidence` enum('unknown','explicit_record') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_account_trade_stable` (`trading_account_id`,`stable_trade_key`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_account_trade_legacy` (`legacy_source_table`,`legacy_id`),
  KEY `idx_account_trade_list` (`user_id`,`trading_account_id`,`closed_at_utc` DESC,`id`),
  KEY `idx_account_trade_business_date` (`user_id`,`trading_account_id`,`close_business_date`,`closed_at_utc` DESC,`id`),
  KEY `idx_account_trade_symbol` (`user_id`,`trading_account_id`,`symbol`,`closed_at_utc` DESC,`id`),
  KEY `idx_account_trade_source` (`user_id`,`trading_account_id`,`source_classification`,`closed_at_utc` DESC,`id`),
  KEY `idx_account_trade_pnl` (`user_id`,`trading_account_id`,`net_profit`,`closed_at_utc` DESC,`id`),
  KEY `idx_account_trade_user_audit` (`user_id`,`closed_at_utc` DESC,`id`),
  KEY `idx_trade_record_ownership_interval` (`ownership_interval_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_account_trade_account` FOREIGN KEY (`trading_account_id`) REFERENCES `trading_accounts` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_account_trade_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_trade_record_ownership_interval` FOREIGN KEY (`ownership_interval_id`) REFERENCES `trading_account_ownership_intervals` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_account_trade_close` CHECK (((`closed_at_utc` is null) or (`closed_at_utc` >= `opened_at_utc`))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_account_trade_currency_evidence` CHECK ((((`currency_evidence` = _utf8mb4'unknown') and (`account_currency` is null)) or ((`currency_evidence` = _utf8mb4'explicit_record') and (`account_currency` is not null) and (char_length(`account_currency`) > 0)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_account_trade_volume` CHECK (((`volume_opened` > 0) and (`volume_closed` >= 0) and (`volume_closed` <= `volume_opened`)))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

  CONSTRAINT `chk_history_task_lease` CHECK ((((`status` in (_utf8mb4'running',_utf8mb4'completing')) and (`lease_token` is not null) and (`lease_expires_at_utc` is not null)) or ((`status` not in (_utf8mb4'running',_utf8mb4'completing')) and (`lease_token` is null) and (`lease_expires_at_utc` is null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_history_task_result` CHECK ((((`status` in (_utf8mb4'pending',_utf8mb4'running',_utf8mb4'completing')) and (`completed_at_utc` is null) and (`result_receipt_id` is null)) or ((`status` = _utf8mb4'succeeded') and (`completed_at_utc` is not null) and (`result_receipt_id` is not null)) or ((`status` = _utf8mb4'failed') and (`completed_at_utc` is not null) and (`result_receipt_id` is null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_history_task_route` CHECK ((((`route_json` is null) and (`route_sha256` is null) and (`status` in (_utf8mb4'pending',_utf8mb4'failed'))) or ((`route_json` is not null) and (`route_sha256` is not null) and regexp_like(`route_sha256`,_utf8mb4'^[0-9a-f]{64}$',_utf8mb4'c')))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_history_task_window` CHECK ((`range_end_utc` > `range_start_utc`))

tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `macro_research_snapshots` (
  `id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `schema_version` smallint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `business_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `data_cutoff_at_utc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `feature_set_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `model_version_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `owner_scope` enum('platform','user') CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `owner_user_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `revision` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `publication_status` enum('legacy','draft','published','superseded','invalidated') CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'legacy',
  `freshness_status` enum('fresh','stale','partial','unavailable') CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unavailable',
  `health_status` enum('healthy','degraded','failed') CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'failed',
  `horizon` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `observed_at_utc` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `valid_until_utc` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `published_at_utc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `superseded_at_utc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `content_sha256` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `payload_json` json NOT NULL,
  `created_at_utc` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `active_publication_key` varchar(96) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((case when ((`publication_status` = _utf8mb4'published') and (`superseded_at_utc` is null)) then concat(convert(coalesce(`horizon`,_ascii'') using utf8mb4),_utf8mb4':',coalesce(cast(`business_date` as char charset utf8mb4),_utf8mb4'')) else NULL end)) STORED,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_macro_snapshot_active_publication` (`active_publication_key`),
  KEY `idx_macro_snapshot_user` (`owner_user_id`,`valid_until_utc`,`observed_at_utc`,`id`),
  KEY `idx_macro_snapshot_platform` (`owner_scope`,`valid_until_utc`,`observed_at_utc`,`id`),
  KEY `idx_macro_snapshot_latest` (`publication_status`,`published_at_utc`,`id`),
  KEY `idx_macro_snapshot_feature` (`feature_set_id`,`data_cutoff_at_utc`,`id`),
  KEY `fk_macro_snapshot_model` (`model_version_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_macro_snapshot_feature` FOREIGN KEY (`feature_set_id`) REFERENCES `macro_feature_sets` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_macro_snapshot_model` FOREIGN KEY (`model_version_id`) REFERENCES `macro_model_versions` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_macro_snapshot_owner` FOREIGN KEY (`owner_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_macro_snapshot_owner` CHECK ((((`owner_scope` = _utf8mb4'platform') and (`owner_user_id` is null)) or ((`owner_scope` = _utf8mb4'user') and (`owner_user_id` is not null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_macro_snapshot_platform_v1` CHECK (((`schema_version` = 0) or ((`owner_scope` = _utf8mb4'platform') and (`owner_user_id` is null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_macro_snapshot_publication` CHECK (((`publication_status` in (_utf8mb4'legacy',_utf8mb4'draft')) or ((`schema_version` > 0) and (`business_date` is not null) and (`data_cutoff_at_utc` is not null) and (`feature_set_id` is not null) and (`horizon` is not null) and (`published_at_utc` is not null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_macro_snapshot_superseded` CHECK ((((`publication_status` = _utf8mb4'superseded') and (`superseded_at_utc` is not null)) or (`publication_status` <> _utf8mb4'superseded'))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_macro_snapshot_timing` CHECK (((`schema_version` = 0) or (`publication_status` in (_utf8mb4'legacy',_utf8mb4'draft')) or ((`data_cutoff_at_utc` <= `published_at_utc`) and (`published_at_utc` < `valid_until_utc`)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_macro_snapshot_validity` CHECK ((`valid_until_utc` > `observed_at_utc`))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

  CONSTRAINT `ck_payment_match_amount` CHECK ((`expected_amount` > 0)),

  CONSTRAINT `ck_payment_match_confirmations` CHECK (((`required_confirmations` is null) or (`required_confirmations` > 0))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_payment_match_origin` CHECK ((((`origin` = _utf8mb4'legacy_import') and (`legacy_watch_id` is not null) and (`legacy_watch_id` > 0) and (`migration_run_id` is not null) and (`source_sha256` is not null) and (`imported_at_utc` is not null)) or ((`origin` = _utf8mb4'native') and (`legacy_watch_id` is null) and (`legacy_confirmations` is null) and (`legacy_wallet_index` is null) and (`migration_run_id` is null) and (`source_sha256` is null) and (`imported_at_utc` is null) and (`required_confirmations` is not null) and (`created_at_utc` is not null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_payment_match_revision` CHECK ((`revision` > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_payment_match_status` CHECK ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'pending',_utf8mb4'confirming',_utf8mb4'confirmed',_utf8mb4'cancelled',_utf8mb4'expired'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_payment_match_window` CHECK ((`expires_at_utc` > `window_start_at_utc`))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

  CONSTRAINT `ck_payment_order_paid_time` CHECK (((`status` <> _utf8mb4'paid') or (`paid_at_utc` is not null))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_payment_order_revision` CHECK ((`revision` > 0)),

CREATE TABLE `referral_credit_ledger` (
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `account_revision` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `event_kind` varchar(24) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `source_key` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `previous_balance` decimal(20,8) DEFAULT NULL,
  `delta` decimal(20,8) DEFAULT NULL,
  `resulting_balance` decimal(20,8) NOT NULL,
  `migration_run_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_sha256` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `recorded_at_utc` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`user_id`,`account_revision`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_referral_credit_event` (`user_id`,`event_kind`,`source_key`),
  KEY `fk_referral_ledger_run` (`migration_run_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_referral_ledger_account` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `user_referral_accounts` (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_referral_ledger_run` FOREIGN KEY (`migration_run_id`) REFERENCES `data_migration_runs` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_referral_ledger_amount` CHECK (((`event_kind` = _utf8mb4'opening') or ((`resulting_balance` = (`previous_balance` + `delta`)) and (((`event_kind` = _utf8mb4'order_debit') and (`delta` < 0) and (`resulting_balance` >= 0)) or ((`event_kind` in (_utf8mb4'order_release',_utf8mb4'commission_credit')) and (`delta` > 0)))))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_referral_ledger_kind` CHECK ((`event_kind` in (_utf8mb4'opening',_utf8mb4'order_debit',_utf8mb4'order_release',_utf8mb4'commission_credit'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_referral_ledger_shape` CHECK ((((`event_kind` = _utf8mb4'opening') and (`account_revision` = 1) and (`previous_balance` is null) and (`delta` is null) and (`migration_run_id` is not null)) or ((`event_kind` <> _utf8mb4'opening') and (`account_revision` > 1) and (`previous_balance` is not null) and (`delta` is not null) and (`migration_run_id` is null))))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

  `legacy_source_table` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,

  UNIQUE KEY `uk_risk_policy_legacy` (`legacy_source_table`,`legacy_id`),
  KEY `idx_risk_policy_owner` (`owner_user_id`,`trading_account_id`,`status`,`id`),
  KEY `fk_risk_policy_account` (`trading_account_id`),
  KEY `fk_risk_policy_active_version` (`active_version_id`,`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_risk_policy_account` FOREIGN KEY (`trading_account_id`) REFERENCES `trading_accounts` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_risk_policy_active_version` FOREIGN KEY (`active_version_id`, `id`) REFERENCES `risk_policy_versions_v4` (`id`, `policy_set_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_risk_policy_owner` FOREIGN KEY (`owner_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_risk_policy_scope` CHECK ((((`scope` = _utf8mb4'platform') and (`owner_user_id` is null) and (`trading_account_id` is null)) or ((`scope` = _utf8mb4'account') and (`owner_user_id` is not null) and (`trading_account_id` is not null))))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

  `kind` enum('analysis','trader') CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `scope` enum('platform','user') CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `owner_user_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `name` varchar(191) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,

  `active_version_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `revision` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `legacy_source_table` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `legacy_id` varchar(191) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at_utc` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `updated_at_utc` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `deleted_at_utc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_strategies_legacy` (`legacy_source_table`,`legacy_id`),
  KEY `idx_strategies_catalog` (`kind`,`status`,`scope`,`owner_user_id`,`deleted_at_utc`,`id`),
  KEY `fk_strategies_owner` (`owner_user_id`),
  KEY `fk_strategies_active_version` (`active_version_id`,`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_strategies_active_version` FOREIGN KEY (`active_version_id`, `id`) REFERENCES `strategy_versions` (`id`, `strategy_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_strategies_owner` FOREIGN KEY (`owner_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_strategies_owner` CHECK ((((`scope` = _utf8mb4'platform') and (`owner_user_id` is null)) or ((`scope` = _utf8mb4'user') and (`owner_user_id` is not null))))

CREATE TABLE `strategy_subscriptions` (

  `standard_symbol` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,

  `revision` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `active_execution_key` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((case when ((`status` = _utf8mb4'active') and (`trader_enabled` = 1)) then concat(cast(`trading_account_id` as char charset utf8mb4),_utf8mb4':',convert(`standard_symbol` using utf8mb4)) else NULL end)) STORED,
  `legacy_source_table` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,

  UNIQUE KEY `uk_strategy_subscription_legacy` (`legacy_source_table`,`legacy_id`),
  KEY `idx_strategy_subscriptions_analysis` (`user_id`,`analysis_strategy_version_id`,`standard_symbol`,`status`,`id`),
  KEY `idx_strategy_subscriptions_account` (`trading_account_id`,`status`,`id`),
  KEY `fk_strategy_subscriptions_analysis` (`analysis_strategy_id`),
  KEY `fk_strategy_subscriptions_analysis_version` (`analysis_strategy_version_id`,`analysis_strategy_id`),

  CONSTRAINT `chk_system_setting_array` CHECK (((`value_type` <> _ascii'json_array') or (`value_text` is null) or (0 <> (case when json_valid(`value_text`) then (json_type(cast(`value_text` as json)) = _utf8mb4'ARRAY') else false end)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_system_setting_boolean` CHECK (((`value_type` <> _ascii'boolean') or (`value_text` is null) or regexp_like(`value_text`,_utf8mb4'^(true|false)$',_utf8mb4'c'))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_system_setting_credential` CHECK (((`value_type` <> _ascii'credential') or (`value_text` is null) or (length(`value_text`) = 0) or (0 <> (case when json_valid(`value_text`) then ((json_type(cast(`value_text` as json)) = _utf8mb4'OBJECT') and json_contains_path(cast(`value_text` as json),_utf8mb4'all',_utf8mb4'$.v',_utf8mb4'$.ct',_utf8mb4'$.iv',_utf8mb4'$.tag')) else false end)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_system_setting_exact_boolean` CHECK (((`value_type` <> _utf8mb4'boolean') or (`value_text` is null) or (cast(`value_text` as char charset binary) in (cast(_utf8mb4'true' as char charset binary),cast(_utf8mb4'false' as char charset binary))))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_system_setting_exact_integer` CHECK (((`value_type` <> _utf8mb4'integer') or (`value_text` is null) or (not(regexp_like(`value_text`,_utf8mb4'[^0-9-]',_utf8mb4'c'))))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_system_setting_exact_tokens` CHECK (((not(regexp_like(`namespace`,_utf8mb4'[^a-z0-9_]',_utf8mb4'c'))) and (not(regexp_like(`setting_key`,_utf8mb4'[^a-z0-9_]',_utf8mb4'c'))) and (not(regexp_like(`value_type`,_utf8mb4'[^a-z_]',_utf8mb4'c'))) and (not(regexp_like(`sensitivity`,_utf8mb4'[^a-z]',_utf8mb4'c'))))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_system_setting_hash` CHECK (((`source_sha256` is null) or regexp_like(`source_sha256`,_ascii'^[0-9a-f]{64}$',_utf8mb4'c'))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_system_setting_identity` CHECK ((regexp_like(`namespace`,_ascii'^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,99}$',_utf8mb4'c') and regexp_like(`setting_key`,_ascii'^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,99}$',_utf8mb4'c'))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_system_setting_integer` CHECK (((`value_type` <> _ascii'integer') or (`value_text` is null) or regexp_like(`value_text`,_utf8mb4'^(0|-?[1-9][0-9]*)$',_utf8mb4'c'))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_system_setting_origin` CHECK ((((cast(`origin` as char charset binary) = cast(_utf8mb4'native' as char charset binary)) and (`created_at_utc` is not null) and (`updated_at_utc` is not null) and (`migration_run_id` is null) and (`source_sha256` is null) and (`imported_at_utc` is null)) or ((cast(`origin` as char charset binary) = cast(_utf8mb4'legacy_import' as char charset binary)) and (`migration_run_id` is not null) and (`source_sha256` is not null) and (`imported_at_utc` is not null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_system_setting_revision` CHECK ((`revision` > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_system_setting_sensitivity` CHECK ((regexp_like(`sensitivity`,_ascii'^(public|restricted|secret)$',_utf8mb4'c') and ((`value_type` <> _ascii'credential') or (`sensitivity` = _ascii'secret')))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_system_setting_type` CHECK (regexp_like(`value_type`,_ascii'^(string|boolean|integer|enum|json_array|credential)$',_utf8mb4'c'))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

tables.name: trading_context_changes_v4
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `trading_context_changes_v4` (
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `request_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `request_sha256` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `action` enum('select_account','enter_observer','leave_observer') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `target_id` varchar(191) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `prior_revision` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `revision` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `result_mode` enum('full','observer','blocked') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `result_account_id` varchar(191) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `result_observer_channel_id` varchar(191) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `result_read_only` tinyint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `recorded_at_utc` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`user_id`,`request_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_context_changes_revision` (`user_id`,`revision`),
  KEY `idx_context_changes_recorded` (`recorded_at_utc`,`user_id`,`revision`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_context_changes_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_context_changes_action_result` CHECK ((((`action` = _utf8mb4'select_account') and (`result_mode` = _utf8mb4'full') and (`result_account_id` = `target_id`)) or ((`action` = _utf8mb4'enter_observer') and (`result_mode` = _utf8mb4'observer') and (`result_observer_channel_id` = `target_id`)) or ((`action` = _utf8mb4'leave_observer') and (`result_mode` in (_utf8mb4'full',_utf8mb4'blocked'))))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_context_changes_read_only` CHECK ((`result_read_only` in (0,1))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_context_changes_result` CHECK ((((`result_mode` = _utf8mb4'full') and (`result_account_id` is not null) and (`result_observer_channel_id` is null)) or ((`result_mode` = _utf8mb4'observer') and (`result_account_id` is null) and (`result_observer_channel_id` is not null) and (`result_read_only` = 1)) or ((`result_mode` = _utf8mb4'blocked') and (`result_account_id` is null) and (`result_observer_channel_id` is null) and (`result_read_only` = 1)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_context_changes_revision` CHECK (((`prior_revision` < 9007199254740991) and (`revision` = (`prior_revision` + 1)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_context_changes_target` CHECK ((((`action` = _utf8mb4'leave_observer') and (`target_id` is null)) or ((`action` in (_utf8mb4'select_account',_utf8mb4'enter_observer')) and (`target_id` is not null) and (char_length(`target_id`) > 0))))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
